===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Intel Atom]] C3558 @2.2GHz (Quad-Core) *Memory: 8GB (DDR4 ECC) SDRAM *Storage: 32MB (SPI Serial) Flash (2x [[Winbond]]), :16GB (NAND eMMC 5.1), 128GB (M.2 SSD) *Network: 6x GbE ports, 2x 10GbE SFP+ slots *PCIe: 1x M.2 (M-Key) slots (used by SSD) *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: 12V/5A via barrel
